versions.title: Edit with Vim keys
versions.summary: An optional Vim mode for the page editor.

highlights.title: Vim keys in pages
highlights.description: Turn on **Vim keys in pages** under Settings, Editor. Press `?` in normal mode to see every key.

Fixed: Deleting everything inside inline code, or a highlight, removes it, so the line is plain again. The right arrow steps out of it at its end, and the left arrow at the start of a line, with a small gap showing where the caret is.
Bullet points fixed: an indented item keeps its letter or number, and a numbered list can start anywhere, like `b)`, `c.` or `12.`, and carries on from there.
A zoomed PDF or document keeps its sideways scroll position when you switch tabs, as well as its place down the page.
Improved: The sentence at the top of the Dashboard names only your next session.
Customize sidebar can now hide Trash too.

versions.title: Math, your way
versions.summary: Define LaTeX commands once and use them everywhere.

highlights.title: Your own LaTeX commands
highlights.description: Add your own commands under Settings, Editor, LaTeX, each with a live preview, starting with a few common ones, and use them in every formula.

versions.title: Tidier code
versions.summary: Format the code in your notes.

highlights.title: Format code blocks
highlights.description: Tidy a code block with the Format button in its header, or turn on **Format code when pasted** in Settings. Undo brings the old code back.

versions.title: A calendar you can tune
versions.summary: Choose how the current day is marked.

highlights.title: Make today stand out
highlights.description: Pick a colour and intensity for the current day in the calendar under Settings.

Fixed: The main content panel lines up with the left navigation panel at the top and bottom.

Improved: The command palette has a New Tab action, with its shortcut shown next to it.

Fixed: Done tasks and assignments with a past due date read like "3 days ago" and never show as overdue.

highlights.title: Highlight text
highlights.description: Type `==text==` or select text and press `Mod+Shift+H` to mark it with a highlighter.

versions.title: Wide tables, easier to read
versions.summary: Keep row labels in view while a table scrolls.

highlights.title: Pin table columns
highlights.description: Use the pin button in the table toolbar to keep the first columns in place while a wide table scrolls sideways.

Fixed: Tab nests a bullet under the one above it, nested items are saved with the page, and Tab no longer jumps out of the editor on the first bullet.
Scrolling a wide table sideways no longer carries the table controls out of reach.

versions.title: Files that open on the right page
versions.summary: Link the same PDF from many notes, each to its own page.

highlights.title: Open a file on a page
highlights.description: Set a page number on a file in a note and it opens on that page, so each note can point to its own part of the same PDF.

Improved: Attachments in the detail sidebar are grouped by type, like Relationships.

Fixed: Cmd+Left on a line with inline math goes to the start of the line, not the top of the note.
Inserting a Math block, Equation, Diagram or Circuit from the slash menu no longer swallows the text above it.
Search lists results that start with what you typed first, so `/in` shows Inline math before headings.

versions.title: Small things, done
versions.summary: Copy IDs, open embedded files and a handful of fixes.

Fixed: Typing after `@` in a page is fast again.
PDFs keep their zoom when you switch tabs, and spreadsheets come back on the same sheet.
Notes keep their scroll position when you switch tabs, and no longer jump to the bottom while loading.
The Dashboard calendar's date header, current time line and scrollbar no longer show over the corner cutout when scrolled.
Searching finds names with accents, so `Ü` or `ubung` finds a file called Übungsblatt in mentions, lists, the Trash and relationship suggestions.
Improved: Right click any item and choose Copy ID, right below Copy Link, to copy the ID you see on it, like `TSK-12`.
Click a file embedded in a page to open it in Nookly, or use Open in Nookly on its toolbar.
A one time reset of the What's new list is gone now that it did its job.
The Dashboard calendar keeps a minimum height of 800 pixels.

versions.title: A roomier Dashboard calendar
versions.summary: The calendar shows more of your day.

Improved: The Dashboard calendar opens two hours before now and keeps a comfortable height even when you have no Jots.

highlights.title: Your day at a glance
highlights.description: Assignments, Tasks, Decks, Jots and today's calendar sit side by side, each showing what matters most first.

Improved: Decks with cards to study today show a play button and leave once you are done.
Jots now list the oldest first.
The sentence at the top of the Dashboard greets you by name, leaves out sessions that already started and points out what matters most. Set your name in Settings under General.
Dashboard links and Show more open Tasks, Assignments or Jots with the matching filters already applied.
Assignments "For today" lists only those tied to a session today, including submitted and graded ones, for presenting in lectures.
Dashboard rows show their Space and a copyable ID, and due dates read as Today, Tomorrow or in 4 days.
Fixed: Tasks due today no longer go missing from the Dashboard sentence for a couple of hours after midnight.

versions.title: Agent files in folders
versions.summary: The Agent settings now list your files down the side, with folders.

Improved: Agent files appear in a list beside the text instead of tabs above it, and you can keep them in folders.

versions.title: What's new after any update
versions.summary: Updating from an older version always shows what changed.

Fixed: The update card and What's new dialog now appear even when Nookly never noted which version you last saw.

versions.title: A cleaner page edge
versions.summary: The main area now matches the sidebar.

Improved: The page has the same border as the left navigation, and it goes away when the sidebar is collapsed.

versions.title: What's new covers every update
versions.summary: Updating after a few versions shows all of them.

Improved: What's new lists every version since the one you were on, newest first, instead of only the latest.

versions.title: Tasks, decks and assignments travel too
versions.summary: Export a task, a deck or an assignment as a Nookly file and bring it back with Import, on this Nookly or another one.

highlights.title: Export a task
highlights.description: Save a task with its subtasks, status, dates and description from its **more actions** menu.

highlights.title: Export a deck
highlights.description: A deck leaves with its cards. Review history stays with you, so imported cards start as new.

highlights.title: Export an assignment
highlights.description: Keep its status, due day, grade and description. When you import it, you choose the course it belongs to.

highlights.title: Import any Nookly file
highlights.description: The Import dialog recognises pages, tasks, decks and assignments and shows what is inside before you confirm.

highlights.title: From the command line
highlights.description: `nookly cli task export` and `import` work for notes, jots, tasks, decks and assignments too.

Improved: Importing never changes what you already have. A bad file is refused with a clear reason and creates nothing.
Labels, links, the Space and review history are never part of a file.

versions.title: Bring pages in, share them out, and link things the easy way
versions.summary: Import and share pages, jot into the session that is running, and a calmer way to relate things to each other.

highlights.title: Import a page
highlights.description: Drop in a page exported from Nookly, choose the Space, relate it to what you have and check what it contains first.

highlights.title: Share a page
highlights.description: Send a page as Markdown or as a Nookly page file through the share menu of your system.

highlights.title: Jot for the session now
highlights.description: Open the jot of the session that is running **right now**, or get told there is none.

highlights.title: Relate in three steps
highlights.description: Pick the **type**, then **how**, then **which one**. Suggestions put the notes of the same course first.

highlights.title: Repeating tasks
highlights.description: Make a task repeat. Finishing it creates the next one.

highlights.title: Agent files
highlights.description: Keep instructions for your own coding agent in Settings, with a starter `AGENTS.md` and a guide to the CLI.

highlights.title: Symbols and emoji
highlights.description: Type `:` in a note and pick a symbol or an emoji, with the common ones ready.

highlights.title: Mention a page of a file
highlights.description: Press the right arrow on a file in the @ menu to pick a page. Clicking the mention opens the file there.

Improved: Search by day or time (Mar 10, Tuesday, 9am) when you relate to, mention or pick a session.
The @ menu groups notes, files, sessions and the rest under their own headings.
Renaming anything updates the mentions of it.
Notifications have a close button, a Clear all bar and their own icon for each kind. Errors stay until you close them.
Wide tables scroll sideways, and table columns can be dragged to a new place.
`Tab` and `Shift+Tab` indent text, and `Mod+Shift+V` pastes without formatting.
Click with **Cmd** (or **Ctrl**) held to open links, images and files.
Every tab remembers where you scrolled to.
Boards can hide a column, and the Assignments item shows the next one that is due.
The time field starts at the hour wherever you click it.
Fixed: A PDF that comes back after being unavailable no longer leaves Nookly blank.
The @ and / menus open again after you have closed them.
Long folder paths no longer run out of the Settings dialog.
